title: AudioDMA Evolution Ring Buffer Protocol & State Machine Specification
description: Exhaustive specification of the circular ring buffer protocols, hardware descriptor queues, channel state machine, and DART translation on Apple Silicon A19 Pro (t8150 / iOS 27.2).

0.name: Uninitialized
0.description: Channel object allocated but apertures and role not yet assigned

1.name: Ready
1.description: Apertures mapped and role/direction assigned; awaiting hardware initialization

2.name: Initializing
2.description: Hardware registers being programmed with default watermarks and interrupts

3.name: Idle
3.description: Channel hardware quiesced and ready to accept stream configuration or transfers

4.name: Configure
4.description: Stream format, bit width, channel count, and FIFO depths being committed

5.name: Introspect
5.description: Channel querying hardware capabilities, latency, or FIFO status

6.name: FirstTransfer
6.description: Initial transfer command enqueued to prime the hardware FIFO pipeline

7.name: Transferring
7.description: Continuous circular ring buffer streaming with active AXI bus burst transfers

8.name: Stopping
8.description: Channel receiving stop command, draining in-flight AXI bursts, quiescing

9.name: Complete
9.description: All submitted transfer descriptors consumed and CS FIFO completions reaped

10.name: Sleeping
10.description: Channel gated into low-power suspended state (kAudioDMAChannelPowerStateSuspended)

0.name: ADMACOPER_SetRoleDirection
0.description: Assign TX or RX direction and subsystem role string

1.name: ADMACOPER_SetApertures
1.description: Assign physical memory mapped I/O apertures (control, TD, CS, PCT FIFOs)

2.name: ADMACOPER_Initialize
2.description: Execute hardware channel reset and default configuration setup

3.name: ADMACOPER_Transfer
3.description: Submit initial transfer request or trigger DMA execution start

4.name: ADMACOPER_Error
4.description: Signal hardware FIFO error, bus timeout, or DMA descriptor fault

5.name: ADMACOPER_ProcessMoreTransfers
5.description: Refill ring buffer with subsequent descriptors while channel is running

6.name: ADMACOPER_Finish
6.description: Commit terminal descriptor in stream to initiate graceful drainage

7.name: ADMACOPER_Stop
7.description: Immediate transfer cancellation and abort request

8.name: ADMACOPER_ProcessDone
8.description: Process completion status from CS FIFO and acknowledge quiescence

9.name: ADMACOPER_Sleep
9.description: Gate channel into suspended power state

10.name: ADMACOPER_Wake
10.description: Restore channel from suspended state to available state

12.name: ADMACOPER_Reset
12.description: Hardware channel pipeline purge and pointer zeroing

13.name: ADMACOPER_ClearIRQ
13.description: Acknowledge and clear pending channel interrupt state

valid_transitions.trigger: Waiting for in-flight AXI burst drain

kAudioDMAChannelPowerStateSuspended.description: Channel clock gated, SRAM retain mode, AXI bus interface asleep

kAudioDMAChannelPowerStateAvailable.description: Channel clock active, operational apertures powered, ready for DMA execution

kAudioDMAControllerPowerStateSuspended.description: Entire ADMAC block clock gated, timebase retention active

kAudioDMAControllerPowerStateAvailable.description: ADMAC global registers active, interrupt dispatch functional

gated_transition_semantics.soft_transition: Preserves channel configurations, watermarks, and pending DART mappings
gated_transition_semantics.hard_transition: Forces full channel reset, purges internal SRAM FIFOs, reloads EDT properties

AddressLow.description: Lower 32 bits of the DART-translated Device Virtual Address (DVA) for the buffer segment

AddressHigh.description: Upper 32 bits of the DART-translated Device Virtual Address (DVA) for the buffer segment

Length.description: Segment payload byte count (must be multiple of programmedAXIBurstSize)

Misc.description: Transfer descriptor control, ID tag, and flags word

TDID.description: Transfer Descriptor ID (0x00 - 0xFF) assigned by software to correlate completions

Flags.description: Channel specific control flags (e.g. Timestamp request, Cache bypass)

IOC.description: Interrupt On Complete: trigger interrupt upon completion of this descriptor

EOT.description: End Of Transfer: marks terminal descriptor in a discrete burst sequence

WRAP.description: Ring Buffer Wrap: instructs hardware pointer to return to ring base

PCT_EN.description: Enable Pre-Calculated Timestamp generation into PCT FIFO

command_status_record_geometry.description: Completion record popped from CS FIFO (reg[2]) upon descriptor completion

ResidualBytes.description: Remaining un-transferred bytes (0 on successful full transfer)

HardwareTimestampLow.description: Hardware LTB timer timestamp at descriptor finish boundary

pct_timestamp_record_geometry.description: Timestamp record popped from PCT FIFO (reg[3]) for sub-sample synchronization

PreCalculatedTimestamp.description: Sample-accurate hardware timestamp synchronized to AON GTB

software_producer.action: Enqueues AudioDMATransferCommand structures into activeTransferCommands queue
software_producer.hardware_interface: Pushes 16-byte descriptors directly into channel TD FIFO register (reg[1])
software_producer.capacity_check: Verified via channelBufferSize and TD FIFO not full condition

hardware_consumer.action: ADMAC DMA execution engine fetches descriptors from TD FIFO, executes AXI bursts
hardware_consumer.cache_control: AXI Read arcache == 0x2, AXI Write awcache == 0x2 (coherent, non-allocating)
hardware_consumer.burst_transfer: Paces data between AXI system memory and channel internal SRAM carveout

hardware_status_producer.action: Upon completing descriptor length, hardware pushes completion token to CS FIFO (reg[2])
hardware_status_producer.timestamp_action: If Attr.PCT_EN is asserted, pushes 64-bit timestamp record to PCT FIFO (reg[3])
hardware_status_producer.interrupt_generation: If Attr.IOC is asserted, asserts channel IRQ bit in CH_IRQ_STAT and TXCH/RXCH_IRQ_STAT

software_status_consumer.drain_loop: Pops CS FIFO records, matches TransDescID against active commands, invokes client completion blocks
software_status_consumer.timestamp_drain: If PCT FIFO active, pops matching timestamp from PCT FIFO to compute jitter histograms

resume.description: Re-validates and restores secure DART page table descriptors
